sentences.text: Therefore, by the impugned order, right of the petitioner to adduce evidence was closed. .

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that an opportunity may be granted to the petitioner to adduce evidence otherwise, the petitioner will not be able to get any compensation under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act.
He further submits that the petitioner is illiterate person and he could not contact to his lawyer and therefore, the evidence could not be adduced.
He prays for setting aside the impugned order and grant of one opportunity to the petitioner to adduce evidence.

Per contra, learned counsel appearing for the respondent No.3/Insurance Company opposed the prayer and submits that several opportunities were granted to the petitioner but he failed to adduce evidence.
Therefore, no further opportunity can be granted and the Claims Tribunal has not committed any error in closing the right of the petitioner to adduce evidence.
Considering the fact that the petitioner has sustained injury in the accident and he moved an application for grant of compensation.
In the considered opinion of this Court and in the interest of justice one more opportunity should be granted to the petitioner to adduce evidence.
Consequently, the petition is allowed and the impugned order dated 14.09.2022 is set-aside with the following directions :
" (i). One single opportunity will be granted to the petitioner for adducing evidence and no adjournment will be granted to the parties;
(ii). Claims Tribunal will try to complete the evidence of the petitioner on the same day and if because of any reason the evidence could not be completed, the trial will go on day-to-day:
(iii).

At the time of passing award, the claims Tribunal will consider the issue that on 14.09.2022, the right of petitioner to adduce evidence was closed by the Claims Tribunal and thereafter, the effect and operation of the impugned order was stayed by this Court in this Petition vide order dated 28.09.2023, therefore, whether, the Insurance Company is liable to pay interest for this period or not?

;
With the aforesaid, present petition is disposed of.
